title: 第5章 古怪的家伙们第6章 快速升级
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
“有那么明显吗？”长着蛇尾巴的狮子疑惑地问道，声音中带着一丝不确定。
他冷哼了一声，满脸的不屑。“这还用问？”
“你的感知力还是和我们第一次见你时一样厉害。”狮子站起身来，边舒展着身体边说道。
“你是说比以前更厉害了。”他朝着狮子面前的地上狠狠地吐了口唾沫，那唾沫星子在阳光下闪烁着。
“不过，你能对付这么多人，还是很厉害。”马艰难地站起身，声音有些虚弱地说道。
“你的腿怎么样了？”狮子看着他，那眼神仿佛在看某种美味的点心。
“好得足以再打掉你几颗牙。”马哼了一声，眼中闪过一丝倔强。
其他人也陆陆续续地站了起来，但都沉默不语。他们的状况比起他们的“朋友”们，显然要糟糕得多，一个个都显得狼狈不堪。
黑豹舔了舔尖锐的牙齿，艾可终于后知后觉地意识到它正紧紧地盯着自己。
“不可能！我在一丛茂密的灌木里，还用了[隐身]！”
他瞬间汗流浃背，惊恐地看着黑豹舔嘴唇的动作，仿佛那是死亡的倒计时。
“怎么了？”狮子问道，顺着黑豹的目光看去。“哦，一份点心。”
艾可只觉得脊背发凉，毫不犹豫地立刻转身，用尽全身的力气使用[冲刺]。
狮子轻声笑了起来。“一份跑得挺快的点心。”
马眯起了眼睛，他是这里年纪最大也最聪明的。这样一个小不点会靠近盯着他们看，听到他们那样的评论后又迅速跑掉，这对他来说实在是毫无道理。
他嘶鸣了一声。“有趣，有趣。”
黑豹用锐利得如同刀刃的眼神看着他。“是吗？我们不能吃了它吗？”
“能。”马轻声笑了笑。“但前提是它不是有灵智的。”
黑豹高兴地大笑起来，笑声在空气中回荡。马大笑一声，然后如同一阵狂风般飞奔而去。
……

艾可在使用冲刺的那一刻，被自己提升了足足20%的速度给惊到了，而且耐力的消耗也没有他预想的那么快。他们的对话让他心惊胆战，满心只想离他们越远越好。他记得动物，尤其是猫科动物，大多不喜欢水，所以他觉得自己最好的办法是过河，然后离马和蜥蜴更远地跑掉。
艾可指望黑豹是这群家伙里最快的，所以如果它不追自己，那自己逃跑就会容易许多。
艾可终于气喘吁吁地遇到了河。此时他的耐力已经所剩无几。他完全没想到会消耗这么多耐力。过了一会儿，耐力消耗得更快了，可能是冲刺的效果……
他毫不犹豫地跳进水里，拼命地游了过去。他费了好大的劲，总算是成功地过去了。
艾可过了河，如释重负地松了一口气。
“有趣。”马对着艾可哼了一声。
这让他瞬间僵住了，他胆战心惊地抬起头来。
“什么鬼？！他们怎么这么快就过河了？！我跳进河里之前还能听到他们在后面！”
当他看到面前的黑豹正舔着嘴唇，露出那尖锐的獠牙时，他差点两眼一黑晕过去。
“我现在能吃了吗？”黑豹对马咆哮道，声音中充满了急切。他尊敬马，但既然人类不怎么好吃，他现在就想来点快餐。
马用后腿重重地跺了跺地，地面都微微颤抖了起来。
“好了，好了！别踢我！”黑豹敏捷地跳开了，眼神中带着一丝畏惧。
艾可的身体被这股强大的压力吓得不停地发抖。他之前观察他们的时候，离他们还有一段距离，所以没有注意到这些细节。现在他真切地注意到了。他唯一的想法是。
“他们完全就是怪物……”
content_en:
"Is it that obvious?" the lion with a snake tail asked doubtfully, with a hint of uncertainty in his voice.
He snorted coldly, his face full of disdain. "Do you even need to ask?"
"Your perception is still as powerful as when we first met you." The lion stood up and said while stretching his body.
"You mean you're even more powerful than before." He spat fiercely on the ground in front of the lion, and the spit stars shone in the sunlight.
"However, you are still very powerful for being able to deal with so many people." Ma stood up with difficulty and said in a weak voice.
"How are your legs?" The lion looked at him, as if looking at some kind of delicious snack.
"Good enough to knock out a few more of your teeth." Ma snorted, a hint of stubbornness flashing in his eyes.
Others stood up one after another, but they were all silent. Their situation was obviously much worse than that of their "friends", and each one of them looked in dire straits.
The black panther licked its sharp teeth, and Echo finally realized belatedly that it was staring closely at him.
"Impossible! I was in a thick bush and I used [Invisibility]!"
He was sweating instantly and watched in horror as the black panther licked his lips, as if it was a countdown to death.
"What's wrong?" the lion asked, following the panther's gaze. "Oh, a snack."
Ai Ke felt a chill running down his spine. He immediately turned around without hesitation and used [Sprint] with all his strength.
The lion chuckled. "A quick snack."
Ma narrowed her eyes, he was the oldest and smartest here. It made no sense to him that such a little kid would stare at them so close and then run away after hearing a comment like that.
He neighed. "Interesting, interesting."
The black panther looked at him with eyes as sharp as blades. "Really? Can't we eat it?"
"Yes." Ma smiled softly. "But only if it's not sentient."
The panther laughed with glee, laughter filling the air. The horse laughed loudly and then galloped away like a gust of wind.
…
The moment Aiko used sprint, he was surprised that his speed increased by a full 20%, and his endurance was not consumed as quickly as he expected. Their conversation frightened him, and he just wanted to stay as far away from them as possible. He remembered that animals, especially cats, mostly didn't like water, so he figured his best bet was to cross the river and run away further away from the horses and lizards.
Echo is counting on the black panther to be the fastest of the group, so if it doesn't chase him, it will be much easier for him to escape.
Aike finally met the river out of breath. At this point, his endurance was running low. He had no idea it would consume so much stamina. After a while, the stamina was consumed faster, possibly due to the effect of sprinting...
He jumped into the water without hesitation and swam as hard as he could. After a lot of effort, he finally managed to get through.
Echo crossed the river and breathed a sigh of relief.
"Interesting." Ma snorted at Aike.
This made him freeze for a moment, and he raised his head fearfully.
"What the hell?! How did they cross the river so quickly?! I could hear them behind me before I jumped into the river!"
When he saw the black panther in front of him licking his lips and showing his sharp fangs, he almost fainted.
"Can I eat it now?" the panther roared to the horse, his voice full of urgency. He respected horses, but since humans weren't very tasty, he wanted some fast food now.
The horse stamped the ground hard with its hind legs, making the ground tremble slightly.
"Okay, okay! Don't kick me!" Black Panther jumped away quickly, with a hint of fear in his eyes.
Ai Ke's body was so frightened by this strong pressure that he kept shaking. before himWhen I observed them, I was still some distance away from them, so I didn't notice these details. Now he really noticed. His only thought was.
"They are complete monsters..."
